regime_evidence.assessment: Retained stablecoin capital and both spot/perp activity remain strong. The ecosystem regime is still qualifying, although derivatives activity is large and crowding remains a risk.

binance_spot_access_test.assessment: The access catalyst is real, but the first post-listing window has not produced an abnormal Binance spot-demand confirmation. HYPE is below the pre-listing/day high rather than breaking out on the new venue.

wallet_quality.independence_adjustment: Do not count the four Paradigm-attributed addresses as four independent distribution votes. They are a correlated cluster/common beneficial-owner candidate. Secondary reports disagree between itemized 883,500 HYPE and rounded ~1.0M HYPE for the Paradigm cluster, so the itemized sum is used here and the discrepancy is preserved.
wallet_quality.countervailing_accumulation: Hyperliquid Strategies was reported to have purchased 1.444M HYPE (~$135M) over the prior week at an average ~$93.70. CoinGecko treasury data independently show +11.68M HYPE activity over 30 days for Hyperliquid Strategies, though treasury datasets disagree on exact current total holdings/timing.
wallet_quality.assessment: Supply risk has increased, but the apparent five-whale exit headline overstates breadth. The strongest identified distribution cluster is Paradigm-linked and has not sold; tokens are still in the seven-day unstaking delay. A separate strategic buyer has accumulated more HYPE over the prior week than the Paradigm-attributed itemized unstake.

caveats: Low circulating fraction / large FDV gap and scheduled future supply remain material dilution risks.
Paradigm-linked unstaking could become sellable on or around October 1 but is not a sale today.
Large derivatives activity and previously observed high open interest create crowding/reflexivity risk.
Binance listing expands distribution but has not yet demonstrated persistent incremental spot demand.

rwa_assessment: No incremental RWA score this run. Hyperliquid L1 shows only ~$6.08M of RWA Active AUM and this scan did not verify a new acceleration in RWA secondary trading or collateral utilization attributable to HYPE demand.
decision: HOLD existing paper HYPE position. Do not add because the Binance spot-access thesis has not yet confirmed demand and the October 1 potential supply overhang has increased. Do not trim because the strong retained-capital/activity regime remains intact, the Paradigm wallets are correlated rather than independent distribution votes, no sale has occurred, and a separate strategic accumulation leg remains material.
forward_tests: Persistent Binance spot volume/share and net buying after the launch window, not just access/listing headlines.
Whether Paradigm-linked HYPE actually moves to spot/exchanges or is restaked after the seven-day delay.
Whether the fifth 100,100 HYPE unstaking address is independently funded/owned or linked to the Paradigm cluster.
Persistence of Hyperliquid stablecoin growth, spot DEX growth, app revenue and fee-funded token value capture.
Actual claimed/transferred supply around upcoming contributor unlocks rather than nominal unlock eligibility alone.
